name: Grigore Sakhnin
source: Euphemia's loyal friend all the way from the childhood. Playing games and growing up together means a lot for both of them. Some time ago Grigore was Rejected by the Great Mycelium and kicked out to the mysterious Eighth Sector, and then their connection was severed. Nobody knows whether he's alive or what even happens to the Rejected.
